# MT E.L.K., INC.

> Hunting call manufacturer based in Livingston, Montana, with product education, call care and dealer/distributor inquiries.

Public product identity checked 2026-11-19. Prices, stock, options and checkout remain in the existing Ecwid store. Original videos and documents retain their original language. Company accounts place the origin in 1985; dated newspaper records begin in 1986. Do not treat the origin date as independently verified incorporation evidence.

## Company, learning and support
- [Compare products](https://www.mtelkinc.com/catalog/compare/): Compare up to three source-backed product guides and share the selection; live prices and checkout stay in the store.
- [About](https://www.mtelkinc.com/about/): Company account and source-linked history.
- [Legacy](https://www.mtelkinc.com/legacy/): Preserved historical records; distinguish dated records from company accounts.
- [Archive](https://www.mtelkinc.com/archive/): Source scans and original document previews.
- [Education](https://www.mtelkinc.com/education/): Search model-specific demonstrations and care lessons.
- [University](https://www.mtelkinc.com/university/): Guided training using existing verified lessons; progress saved in this browser.
- [Videos](https://www.mtelkinc.com/videos/): Embedded on-site video library.
- [Call care](https://www.mtelkinc.com/banding/): Model-specific band and reed replacement resources.
- [Support](https://www.mtelkinc.com/support/): Product and customer support.
- [Contact](https://www.mtelkinc.com/contact/): Published phone and email contact options.
- [Dealer applications](https://www.mtelkinc.com/dealer-application/): Dealer/distributor qualification inquiry, subject to review; no automatic approval.
- [U.S. dealers](https://www.mtelkinc.com/dealers/us/): Application process and retailer resources; not an authorized dealer directory.
- [Canada](https://www.mtelkinc.com/canada/): Regional distributor inquiries; Western pilot planning, not confirmed national distribution.
- [International](https://www.mtelkinc.com/international/): Research and legacy chapters; not a list of confirmed shipping markets.
- [Policies](https://www.mtelkinc.com/disclosures/): Current policy pages; confirm order-specific and wholesale terms directly.
